title: Harness review-return hooks
reopenReason: founder-rejected v3: hooks were the RIGHT mechanism but v3 abandoned them for a re-prompt-loop + sandbox-instruction-file-rewrite workaround (soft, expensive, not actually a hook). Correct design: provision a real turn-end/stop hook into EACH harness's NATIVE hook system as part of harness-adapter / sandbox setup — the same provisioning pattern as skills/MCP/AGENTS.md. All modern harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) support hooks. The harness itself enforces the return natively + uniformly; HyperIdle provisions the hook per-adapter. Not Claude-specific, not a re-prompt loop.
notes: v4: hook provisioning as first-class sandbox/harness-adapter setup. Replace v3 re-prompt loop + sandbox-file carrier. Keep closed return set + not_returned outcome semantics. Prove on an external non-Claude harness via its native hook.
history: v1=flag-only (rejected), v2=Claude-only SDK hook (rejected), v3=harness-agnostic re-prompt loop / instruction-file rewrite (rejected: not a real hook), v4=native hook provisioned per-harness at sandbox setup
